# HST Architects

> HST Architects is a Dubai interior design, renovation and landscaping studio delivering turnkey villas, offices, showrooms and outdoor spaces across the UAE.

HST Architects is the design practice of HST Group, a licensed UAE building maintenance and technical
services company operating from Boulevard Plaza Tower 1, Office 1603, Downtown Dubai. The studio delivers design
and build under one contract: interior design, renovation and fit-out, and landscaping.

- Founded: 2015
- Location: Boulevard Plaza Tower 1, Office 1603, Downtown Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Phone: +971 50 399 9314 / +971 4 332 2002
- Email: info@hstglobal.co
- Hours: Saturday to Thursday, 09:00-18:00 Gulf Standard Time
- Areas served: Dubai, Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, Dubai Marina, Emirates Hills, Palm Jumeirah, Damac Hills, Dubai Hills Estate, District One, Jumeirah, Al Barsha, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah

## Services
- [Interior Design](https://hstarchitects.com/services/interior-design/): Concept, space planning and 3D visualisation for villas, offices and showrooms.
- [Renovation & Fit-Out](https://hstarchitects.com/services/renovation/): Turnkey refurbishment and fit-out, delivered by the team that drew it.
- [Landscaping](https://hstarchitects.com/services/landscaping/): Gardens, pools, pergolas and roof terraces built for the Gulf climate.

- [Springfield Properties HQ](https://hstarchitects.com/projects/springfield-properties-office/): Fit-Out, Business Bay, Dubai, 2020.
- [Private Villa, Emirates Hills](https://hstarchitects.com/projects/emirates-hills-villa/): Interior, Emirates Hills, Dubai, 2022.
- [Gym Renovation, Al Wasl](https://hstarchitects.com/projects/al-wasl-gym/): Renovation, Al Wasl, Dubai, 2023.

- [Mehr o Mah Art Café](https://hstarchitects.com/projects/mehr-o-mah-art-cafe/): Hospitality, Jumeirah 1, Dubai, 2022.
- [IMA Gallery Showroom](https://hstarchitects.com/projects/ima-gallery-showroom/): Retail, Art of Living Mall, Dubai, 2021.
- [DNG Furniture Showroom](https://hstarchitects.com/projects/dng-furniture-showroom/): Retail, Al Barsha One, Dubai, 2022.
- [Penthouse Redesign, Dubai Marina](https://hstarchitects.com/projects/marina-penthouse/): Residential, Dubai Marina, 2023.
- [Roof Garden, District One](https://hstarchitects.com/projects/district-one-roof-garden/): Landscape, District One, Dubai, 2023.
- [Office Renovation, Emirates NBD Building](https://hstarchitects.com/projects/nbd-office-renovation/): Fit-Out, Deira, Dubai, 2021.
- [Private Office, Business Bay](https://hstarchitects.com/projects/business-bay-private-office/): Interior, Business Bay, Dubai, 2023.
- [Private Villa, Jumeirah](https://hstarchitects.com/projects/jumeirah-villa/): Residential, Jumeirah, Dubai, 2022.
